items.title: Chewy Slides 6% on Second Downgrade in Two Days as JPMorgan Cuts Target to $24; Petco Stays Put, Freshpet Nudges Higher
items.summary: Two analyst downgrades in back-to-back sessions have Chewy stock cratering while the broader market climbs, and the reasoning behind both cuts points to a force that Chewy's own strong execution simply cannot overcome.

items.title: Can Greece Add Another Growth Lever for JPMorgan in Europe?
items.summary: JPM's Greece corporate banking push broadens its European growth strategy, opening more cross-selling opportunities across lending, payments and IB.

items.title: Equity risk premium falls to 2002 levels. What it means for stocks
items.summary: Investing.com -- JPMorgan warned in a note this week that the equity risk premium, the extra expected return investors demand for holding stocks over bonds, has shrunk to its lowest level since 2002, with implications for how equities behave from here.

items.title: Is JPMorgan Chase & Co. (JPM) a Buy as Wall Street Analysts Look Optimistic?
items.summary: Based on the average brokerage recommendation (ABR), JPMorgan Chase & Co. (JPM) should be added to one's portfolio. Wall Street analysts' overly optimistic recommendations cast doubt on the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric. So, is the stock worth buying?

items.title: JPMorgan cautious on Hims & Hers on GLP-1 transition risk
items.summary: Investing.com -- JPMorgan revealed Friday that it has started coverage of Hims & Hers Health at Neutral, setting a December 2027 price target of $32 as it weighs the direct-to-consumer health platform's rapid growth against execution risks in its shift to branded weight-loss drugs.

items.title: Chewy Shares Fall 1.9% as JPMorgan Cuts Rating to Neutral
items.summary: Chewy (NYSE:CHWY) shares fell 1. 9% in premarket trading after JPMorgan downgraded the online pet retailer to Neutral from Overweight and lowered its price target to $24 from $29.

items.title: Top Funds Aren't Fooling Around. Witness Massive Bets On CrowdStrike And Beyond.
items.summary: As the best mutual funds poured CrowdStrike and Marvell, Palantir also returned to this monthly screen for the first time this year.

items.title: Bitcoin's Correlation With Gold Is Near an All-Time High. Does That Make Bitcoin a Buy?
items.summary: Bitcoin has been pitched as a diversifying asset, but its correlation with gold isn't as positive as some may suggest.
